plan.expected: The app should refuse to book an appointment on a past date. It should show an error such as 'appointment date cannot be in the past' and not save the booking.

Verify that the app shows an error saying the date is in the past and the appointment was not saved.

ticket.title: Appointments can be booked on past dates with no error
steps: Log in to the clinic app as a Sunrise Clinic user
Go to Appointments and click '+ Book appointment'
Select patient 'Aisha Rahman'
Set the date to 2025-03-03 and the time to 10:00
Click 'Book appointment'
ticket.expected: The booking is refused, the user stays on the form, and an error such as 'Appointment date cannot be in the past' is shown. Nothing is saved.
ticket.actual: The form is accepted and the user is redirected (POST /appointments/new returns 303). The patient page then shows a saved appointment on 03 Mar 2025 · 10:00, and no error or warning appears.

attempts.fixer_said:
The app was saving bookings on any valid date, including dates that had already passed, so the 3 March 2025 booking went through with no warning. I added a check in `validate_appointment` (`app.py:247`) that turns down dates before today. The booking form now stays open with "The appointment date cannot be in the past. The appointment was not saved." and nothing is saved.

I tried to run a quick check of the new validation, but that command needed an approval that wasn't given, so I haven't run it yet. Kane's re-run will be the first real test.
